title: How long can each sea mammal live?
prompt: Place each one by the lifespan figure NOAA reports.

items.label: Bearded seal
items.fact: Bearded seals are the largest Arctic seal species, and NOAA reports a lifespan of about 25 years.

items.label: Spotted seal
items.fact: Spotted seals form breeding-season family groups made up of a female, a male, and a pup.

items.label: Narwhal
items.fact: Narwhals may live up to 50 years, and newborn calves are about 5.2 feet long.

items.label: Cuvier's beaked whale
items.fact: The longest known Cuvier's beaked whale dive lasted 222 minutes.

items.label: North Atlantic right whale
items.fact: More than 85 percent of North Atlantic right whales have been entangled in fishing gear at least once.

items.label: Killer whale
items.fact: Killer whales are the largest members of the dolphin family and occur in every ocean.
